info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Beverage Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of beverage syrup catalog details, enabling users to create and maintain syrup product information. It supports operations to define key attributes such as syrup types, flavors, and ingredient details. Ideal for beverage manufacturers and distributors, this API allows for seamless integration of syrup products into their inventory systems. Users can efficiently manage their beverage offerings, ensuring accurate and up-to-date catalog representation.

post.description: This operation allows you to create the details for a beverage syrup. Utilize this endpoint to submit the necessary data for a new syrup product, ensuring it meets the required specifications.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create or update beverage syrup information in the system. The data provided should comply with the specified schema to ensure proper processing.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the details are returned.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the beverage syrup.

warehouseCodes.description: List of warehouse codes where the syrup is stored.
